review_criteria: Does the image show a cell population consistent with an unexpectedly low or unusually distributed annotation count?
Is the image acquisition obviously degraded (focus, exposure, artefact)?
Is the annotation plausible despite the low count?
reviewer_note: no qualified scientific reviewer is currently supplied; no judgment, reason or expertise field is fabricated and no expert validation is claimed. Real-world precision is unmeasured.
sampling_caveat: enriched (top-ranked + random) sample; do not read an unweighted population precision estimate from it
sampling_method: disjoint strata: top Isolation Forest (seed 42), top robust statistical baseline, top low-count baseline, then a deterministic random sample of the remainder (seed 42); each stratum takes up to 25 rows already not selected by an earlier stratum
